text:
deploy-bot: [canary] starting rollout: runtime v2.7.0 + sdk 1.6.0 -> canary-cluster-a (20% traffic). change window 14:00-16:00 UTC. rollback window 15:00 UTC. dashboard: https://console/redwood/deploy/1779123456 :rocket:

maria: FYI SDK 1.6.0 includes tokenization normalization change. models trained against legacy tokenization may see subtle diffs. we should consider pinning model variants or rolling SDK back on canary.

kevin: running evals against rwd/gptx-3a-quant: observed ~2.1% drop in formatting tests, a handful of hallucination diffs. small but reproducible.

tess: @runtime-oncall any errors in the canary logs?

runtime-oncall: quick log snippet from model-router at 14:07:
```
[14:07:12] model-router: incoming request model=rwd/gptx-3a-quant runtime=2.7.0 sdk=1.6.0
[14:07:12] model-server ERROR: TokenizationMismatchError: expected vocab_size=50257 got=50260
[14:07:12] runtime: falling back to slow-tokenizer at request path /v1/generate
```

sdk-lead: we intentionally normalized unicode and some punctuation in 1.6.0 to improve consistency. seems we missed a compatibility shim for quantized variants. options: 1) patch SDK quickly (1.6.1) with legacy flag, 2) rollback SDK to 1.5.2 on canary, 3) pin runtime->model combos in routing table.

maria: my vote is immediate rollback to 1.5.2 on canary so we don't risk cascading diffs while SDK patch is prepared. then add an explicit compatibility entry in the model catalog.

oliver: agreed. command I propose: `/deploy rollback sdk 1.5.2 --target canary --reason "tokenizer regression"`

deploy-bot: Executing: rollback sdk 1.5.2 -> canary-cluster-a. Started at 14:12 UTC. ETA ~2m.

kevin: re-running evals after rollback (14:16). preliminary numbers: formatting tests back to baseline. :thumbsup:

tess: can we add a gating check in the rollout pipeline that verifies tokenization vocab_size for model variants? if mismatch, fail canary and notify owners. filing ticket.

runtime-oncall: will add a readiness probe check that validates vocab_size and tokenization schema for runtime 2.8. pushing to backlog with priority P2.

sdk-lead: I'll cut 1.6.1 with a compatibility shim + opt-out flag (legacy_tokenizer=true). aim to have PR and CI green by EOD. once patched we can re-run canary with 1.6.1 and explicit tests.

maria: action items recorded in release notes: - rolled back SDK to 1.5.2 on canary at 14:12 UTC - ticket #1234 created for tokenization gate - runtime readiness probe task created. include note in changelog about tokenizer normalization in 1.6.0 and compatibility guidance for quantized model variants.

kevin: thanks all. we should also notify customer success if any dedicated/private customers using gptx-3a-quant have upgraded SDK recently.

sdk-lead: will send short advisory draft to #customer-success after patch merges.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: sdk 1.5.2 -> canary-cluster-a. 14:14 UTC.

maria: moving to close. will reopen if regressions reappear. :white_check_mark:
